decisions.reason: Chinese 大統曆法二立成 has no leading triangle; the idiomatic ▲ is an invented mark and removing it restores fidelity without changing the wording.

The chapter text reads 至正十七年, which the current English accurately renders as Zhizheng. Wikisource's Siku Mingshi likewise has 至正十七年, while Yuan History 曆志 has 至元十七年 for the Season Granting Calendar; that citation error is source-critical annotation, not a license to rewrite the Mingshi wording into Zhiyuan.

Literal English correctly translates received 至正 as Zhizheng. Emending to Zhiyuan (AD 1280) would misrepresent the Mingshi lemma; Yuan History's 十七年冬至，曆成…授時曆 confirms the historical date but does not alter what this chapter says.
